overview: In-Product Automation REST API for the NetApp Console

ai-gen.keywords: in-product automation,ipa,license enforcement,netapp support site,nss,support
ai-gen.lead: Manage license enforcement and policy-driven operational control across NetApp product families with the In-Product Automation (IPA) service. Use the endpoints to work with licenses, services, NetApp Support Site (NSS) data, and support.
Registers a license with IPA, activating the license for use within the service. Use this to enable features or services tied to the registered license.
ai-gen.keywords: license register,serial number register,account license,license registration,netapp license

ai-gen.lead: Deregisters a license from IPA.
ai-gen.keywords: license deregistration,serial number deregistration,ipa license,cloud account license,deregister license

ai-gen.lead: Retrieves the license registration status, providing information about the current state of license activation. Use this to verify whether licenses are properly registered.
ai-gen.keywords: license registration,status check,serial number verification,registration status,license status

ai-gen.lead: Retrieves an IPA license status, providing information about the current licensing state for the IPA service.
ai-gen.keywords: ipa license,status check,license validation,serial number lookup,account license

ai-gen.lead: Authenticates an IPA license (v5), verifying its validity for use with the IPA service. Use this to ensure compliance and access to licensed features.
ai-gen.keywords: ipa license,license authentication,v5 license,netapp console,ipa authenticate

ai-gen.lead: Retrieves an IPA license status (v6), providing information about the current license configuration. Use this to verify licensing details for the IPA service.
ai-gen.keywords: ipa license,status v6,license status,serial number,status check,netapp console

x-doc.title: Retrieve an IPA serial number token

ai-gen.lead: Retrieves an IPA serial number token. Use this token for authentication with the NetApp Console service.
ai-gen.keywords: ipa serial number,serial number token,netapp console,serial lookup,service token

ai-gen.lead: Retrieves an IPA serial number. Use this to view the serial number associated with an IPA device.
ai-gen.keywords: ipa services,serial number lookup,netapp console,license protocol,license package,host id

x-doc.title: Retrieve NetApp Support Site key credentials

ai-gen.lead: Retrieves the NetApp Support Site key credentials for a specified NetApp Support Site ID. Use this to access credentials associated with your Support Site account.
ai-gen.keywords: netapp support site,netapp credentials,nss key,account id support,key retrieval,netapp id

x-doc.title: Update NetApp Support Site key credentials

ai-gen.lead: Updates NetApp Support Site key credentials to refresh the authentication information used for accessing NetApp services. Use this to ensure that the credentials remain valid and up to date.
ai-gen.keywords: netapp support,update credentials,support site key,nss key,account credentials

x-doc.title: Delete NetApp Support Site key credentials

x-doc.title: Retrieve a list of NetApp Support Site key credentials

ai-gen.keywords: netapp support site,account credentials,nss keys,resource data,service request

x-doc.title: Create NetApp Support Site key credentials

ai-gen.lead: Creates NetApp Support Site key credentials. Use this to generate credentials for accessing NetApp Support Site resources.
ai-gen.keywords: netapp support,netapp key,create credentials,nss key,netapp console

x-doc.title: Create an IDaaS NetApp Support Site key credential

ai-gen.keywords: identity service,key credential,support site,netapp console,account id,id management

ai-gen.lead: Associates a resource with a specified NetApp Support Site key. Use this to link resources to your support account for tracking and management.

x-doc.title: Update a resource NetApp Support Site key

ai-gen.lead: Retrieves NetApp Support Site credentials for a specified resource ID, validating them if the validateKey field is true. Use this to confirm access credentials for integration or troubleshooting purposes.

ai-gen.lead: Retrieves a NetApp Support Site user B2C access token, which is required for authenticating and accessing NetApp Console services.

x-doc.title: Retrieve NetApp Support Site data for accounts

x-doc.title: Retrieve NetApp Support Site data for an account and key ID

ai-gen.keywords: system entitlements,serial number check,case creation eligibility,netapp support,entitlement validation

ai-gen.lead: Retrieves a list of support cases based on specified filter parameters. Use this to review cases that match your criteria for further analysis or action.
ai-gen.keywords: support cases,case search,retrieve cases,filter cases,support case list

ai-gen.keywords: support case,retrieve case details,case details,case number,fetch attachments

x-doc.title: Update support case notes or status

categories.title: License endpoints in the In-Product Automation REST API for the NetApp Console

ai-gen.lead: Use license endpoints to register, deregister, and check the status of NetApp Console licenses within the IPA service. These endpoints support license management across multiple IPA service versions, ensuring compatibility and accurate status tracking.
ai-gen.keywords: license registration,deregistration,license management,registration status,license status

categories.title: Services endpoints in the In-Product Automation REST API for the NetApp Console

ai-gen.lead: Use the services endpoints to retrieve serial numbers and their lookup tokens within the NetApp Console environment. These endpoints handle operations like consulting lookup services and serial number services to streamline identification processes.
ai-gen.keywords: serial number lookup,serial number token,serial number retrieval,lookup token,token retrieval

categories.title: NetApp Support Site endpoints in the In-Product Automation REST API for the NetApp Console

ai-gen.lead: Use NetApp Support Site endpoints to manage keys, migrate resources, and retrieve access tokens within the NetApp Console IPA service. These endpoints support tasks such as updating key associations, performing migrations, and accessing registration details.
ai-gen.keywords: support site key,migrate key,key management,resource association,access token,username retrieval

categories.title: Support endpoints in the In-Product Automation REST API for the NetApp Console

ai-gen.lead: Use support endpoints to verify system entitlements and create support cases directly within the NetApp Console. These operations help ensure proper access and streamline case management for your systems.
ai-gen.keywords: support case,case creation,system entitlements,serial number entitlement,support operations
